frontend_active_index: /_content/index.json -> the activated complete release index; atomic pointer resolution, no-store
frontend_immutable_root: /_content/releases/<release_id>/; index.json and pages/<id>.json; immutable hash-verified release
consistency: Load one active index, fetch referenced pages from its pinned immutable release, verify manifest and DTOs; never mix latest DB catalogue with an old page. Failed activation retains previous index/pages/catalogue/sitemap/redirects.
public_urls: Every published ContentPage.get_absolute_url, every published home /<slug>/ alias with canonical/, robots/sitemap, retained active redirects only after404; assets are the union of per-page Asset descriptors. No account/admin/private API/unpublished content.
catalogue_query: QueryDict.get last singleton; unknown params ignored; grade valid among topic grades else empty; subjects dedupe by slug after grade filter, keep first entity; invalid subject becomes empty; q Python strip then Unicode casefold substring of topic title, no normalization; ordering unchanged.
catalogue_render: q nonempty gives flat results with grade/subject/section labels; q empty regroup by entity grade/subject/section in stable topic order; selected grade/subject opens sections; zero matches shows baseline empty state/count0; fallback labels from templates/includes/catalogue.html
